Every {1} minutes the scanner checks {2} coins on {3}-hour candles. Strength = how strongly the pattern’s condition holds; confidence = how many other same-direction signals confirm it. The record shows what the same pattern did {4} hours later in the past. “{5}h” and “{6}d” are the same coin’s trend on the {7}-hour and daily charts: ✅ agrees with the finding, ⚠️ contradicts it.
